statement: Flavio Bolsonaro wins the Brazilian presidential runoff held on 2026-10-25, defeating Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva with more than 50 percent of valid votes.
resolution: TRUE if the Superior Electoral Court (TSE) official result for the 2026-10-25 presidential runoff gives Flavio Bolsonaro more than 50 percent of valid votes; otherwise FALSE.
failure_condition: Flavio Bolsonaro does not receive more than 50 percent of valid votes in a presidential runoff held on 2026-10-25.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class
control_basis.note: pre-registered before the outcome existed. This is the floor the forecaster arm must clear; it is not an attempt to be right.

statement: In the Spanish general election held on 2026-11-29, PP lists and Vox lists together win at least 176 of the 350 seats in the Congress of Deputies.
resolution: TRUE if Interior Ministry or Central Electoral Board results for the 2026-11-29 general election, including the overseas vote, give PP lists (including PP-led coalitions) and Vox at least 176 Congress seats combined; otherwise FALSE.
failure_condition: PP and Vox lists hold 175 or fewer of the 350 Congress seats after the 2026-11-29 election, or no general election is held on that date.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class
control_basis.note: pre-registered before the outcome existed. This is the floor the forecaster arm must clear; it is not an attempt to be right.

statement: In a floor vote held between 2027-01-03 and 2027-01-15, the US House of Representatives elects a Democrat as Speaker of the 120th Congress following the 2026-11-03 midterm elections.
resolution: TRUE if a roll call recorded by the Clerk of the House between 2027-01-03 and 2027-01-15 elects a Democratic member as Speaker of the 120th Congress; otherwise FALSE.
failure_condition: By 2027-01-15 the House has elected a Republican or other non-Democrat as Speaker of the 120th Congress, or has elected no Speaker.

statement: At its meeting concluding on 2026-10-28, the FOMC raises the federal funds target range above the 3.75-4.00 percent range in force at seal.
resolution: TRUE if the FOMC statement released on 2026-10-28 sets a target range upper bound above 4.00 percent, shown by FRED series DFEDTARU for 2026-10-29; otherwise FALSE. Reference: 3.75-4.00 percent on the packet date.
failure_condition: The federal funds target range upper bound remains at or below 4.00 percent after the 2026-10-28 FOMC decision.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class
control_basis.note: pre-registered before the outcome existed. This is the floor the forecaster arm must clear; it is not an attempt to be right.

statement: The ECB euro foreign exchange reference rate for the US dollar published for 2026-11-27 is below 1.1000 dollars per euro.
resolution: TRUE if the ECB USD reference rate published for 2026-11-27 is below 1.1000; FALSE if it is 1.1000 or higher. Reference: EUR/USD 1.12 on the packet date.
failure_condition: The ECB USD reference rate published for 2026-11-27 is at or above 1.1000.

resolution: TRUE if UKMTO incident notices record at least three distinct incidents dated 2026-10-12 to 2026-10-25 of merchant vessels struck by weapons or seized in the Strait of Hormuz, Persian Gulf or Gulf of Oman; otherwise FALSE.
failure_condition: Fewer than three distinct weapon strikes on or seizures of merchant vessels take place in the Strait of Hormuz, Persian Gulf or Gulf of Oman between 2026-10-12 and 2026-10-25.

resolution: TRUE if between 2026-10-05 and 2026-11-13 the White House and the Iranian government each publicly confirm a US-Iran ceasefire or truce, as reported by at least two of Reuters, AP and AFP; otherwise FALSE.
failure_condition: No US-Iran ceasefire or truce is confirmed by both governments at any point from 2026-10-05 through 2026-11-13.

statement: Between 2026-10-05 and 2026-11-13, Japanese prosecutors indict the US Marine arrested on Okinawa on 2026-10-04 over the killing of a 39-year-old woman in a Naha hotel.
resolution: TRUE if Kyodo or NHK reports the Naha District Public Prosecutors Office indicted that Marine on murder, robbery-murder or any other charge tied to the death, with the indictment dated 2026-10-05 to 2026-11-13; otherwise FALSE.
failure_condition: The Marine has not been indicted on any charge tied to the death by 2026-11-13, whether due to psychiatric evaluation detention, release pending disposition, or a decision not to prosecute.

resolution: TRUE if the GDACS event record for tropical cyclone KOGUMA-26 shows an Orange or Red alert level at any episode issued between 2026-10-05 and 2026-10-19; FALSE if every episode in that window is Green.
failure_condition: KOGUMA-26 never reaches Orange or Red impact level in any GDACS episode issued between 2026-10-05 and 2026-10-19.
